wrist-rest-features.description: Lists special functional or design characteristics that add value

xlr-pin-count.description: Indicates the specific pin configuration (number of pins) of the XLR connectors
xlr-pin-count.name: XLR pin count

yacht-type.description: Classifies the type of yacht, such as motor or explorer

yam-variety.description: Specifies the cultivar or common variety of yam being sold (e.g., purple, yellow, elephant foot).

yarn-cutter-physical-style.description: Identifies the physical style of a yarn cutter (e.g., pendant, ring, snips) to support browsing and filtering within this category.

yarn-finish-or-effect.description: Highlights special visual or functional treatments applied to the yarn such as fluorescence or metallic sparkle.

yarn-guide-style.description: The physical style of the yarn guiding component.
yarn-guide-style.name: Yarn guide style

yarn-swift-adjustability.description: Indicates whether and how the swift can be adjusted (expandable, collapsible/foldable), affecting storage and the range of skein sizes it can handle.

yarn-swift-bearing-type.description: Describes the rotation support mechanism (e.g., ball bearing) that affects smoothness and winding speed.
yarn-swift-bearing-type.name: Yarn swift bearing type

yarn-weight-category.description: Identifies the thickness of yarn, like super bulky or craft
yarn-weight-category.name: Yarn weight category

yeast-application.description: Indicates the primary intended culinary or fermentation use of the yeast product.
yeast-application.name: Yeast application

yo-yo-accessory-part-type.description: Identifies what kind of yo-yo replacement part or accessory the product is (e.g., string, bearing, response pads).
yo-yo-accessory-part-type.name: Yo-yo accessory/part type

yo-yo-axle-system-type.description: Construction approach for the yo-yo axle (e.g., fixed axle vs transaxle), impacting play feel and maintenance.
yo-yo-axle-system-type.name: Yo-yo axle system type

yo-yo-bearing-size-class.description: Standardized bearing size class used by the yo-yo, where applicable.
yo-yo-bearing-size-class.name: Yo-yo bearing size class

yo-yo-bearing-type.description: Bearing configuration that influences responsiveness and spin characteristics.
yo-yo-bearing-type.name: Yo-yo bearing type

yo-yo-play-style.description: Primary intended play style of the yo-yo, reflecting the string/trick discipline the product is designed for.

yo-yo-response-system.description: Specifies the yo-yo response mechanism this part is designed for (compatibility).

yo-yo-responsiveness.description: Whether the yo-yo returns to the hand with a tug (responsive) or requires a bind (unresponsive).

yo-yo-string-material.description: Material composition of the yo-yo string.
yo-yo-string-material.name: Yo-yo string material

yogurt-base-ingredient.description: Identifies the primary milk or plant-based source used to make the yogurt, critical for dietary preferences and allergen considerations.

yoke-type.description: Identifies the style of cradle or yoke that supports the firearm on the monopod.

zills-strap-adjustability.description: Whether and how the included strap/elastic can be adjusted for fit.

zipper-application.description: Specifies the intended project or application the zipper is designed for.
zipper-application.name: Zipper application

zipper-chain-type.description: Specifies the construction/type of the zipper chain/teeth.
zipper-chain-type.name: Zipper chain type

zipper-end-type.description: Indicates how the zipper terminates and whether it separates (open-end) or is closed-end (non-separating), including common separating-end hardware used in craft zippers.
zipper-end-type.name: Zipper end type

zipper-gauge.description: Indicates the zipper chain gauge/size designation, typically expressed as a number with a # (for example, #3 or #5), which correlates to tooth/coil width and intended use.
zipper-gauge.name: Zipper gauge

zipper-opening-length.description: Defines how much of the front opening is zippered, distinguishing full-zip from half-zip or quarter-zip styles.
zipper-opening-length.name: Zipper opening length

zipper-pull-material.description: Specifies the material of the zipper pull or pull tab (the part you grip), distinct from the zipper teeth/chain and tape.
zipper-pull-material.name: Zipper pull material

zipper-pull-side.description: Specifies which side(s) of the zipper the pull tab is accessible from.
zipper-pull-side.name: Zipper pull side

zipper-pull-strap-cord-tab-material.description: Material of the strap/cord/tab/tassel component attached to the zipper pull (if present), excluding the main zipper pull hardware/body.
zipper-pull-strap-cord-tab-material.name: Zipper pull strap/cord/tab material

zipper-pull-style.description: Describes the design or finish on a zipper pull, such as textured or embossed
zipper-pull-style.name: Zipper pull style

zipper-reversibility-mechanism.description: Specifies how the zipper is reversible (e.g., double-sided slider vs flip/auto-lock slider designed for reversible garments).
zipper-reversibility-mechanism.name: Zipper reversibility mechanism

zipper-separating-type.description: Indicates whether the zipper separates at the bottom/top or is closed-end, for fit with jackets, sleeping bags, bags, etc.
zipper-separating-type.name: Zipper separating type

zipper-side.description: Specifies the side on which the main zipper is located when the sleeping bag is lying face-up.
zipper-side.name: Zipper side

zipper-slider-material.description: Specifies the material of the zipper slider (the moving mechanism), which can impact strength and corrosion resistance.
zipper-slider-material.name: Zipper slider material

zipper-slider-pull-configuration.description: Indicates whether the zipper has one slider/pull or two, and whether pulls are on one or both sides of the slider.
zipper-slider-pull-configuration.name: Zipper slider/pull configuration

zipper-style.description: Indicates the zipper length or presence on the garment (e.g., zipless, quarter-zip, half-zip, full-zip).
zipper-style.name: Zipper style

zipper-tape-material.description: Specifies the primary material of the zipper tape (fabric sides) that is sewn into the project.
zipper-tape-material.name: Zipper tape material

zipper-teeth-type.description: Specifies the construction style of the zipper chain/teeth (e.g., coil, molded plastic, metal, invisible), which affects flexibility, strength, and typical applications.
zipper-teeth-type.name: Zipper teeth type

zoom-type.description: Specifies the type of zoom function in document cameras, such as digital or optical
zoom-type.name: Zoom type
